content.text:
I've got plenty of material! Here's a fun, satirical rap battle script based on the real moments, phrases, and controversies from the 2016 presidential debates. This is entirely fictional and comedic in nature — enjoy! 🎤

---

# 🎤 THE PRESIDENTIAL RAP BATTLE OF 2016 🎤
### *"Make America Rhyme Again"*
**Venue: Hofstra University**
**Host (Moderator): Lester Holt**
**Crowd: Absolutely losing their minds**

---

*[Beat drops. Crowd goes wild. Lester Holt adjusts his tie nervously.]*

---

**LESTER HOLT:**
*Yo, welcome to the battle of the century's most epic night,*
*Two candidates on stage, only one walks out right.*
*The rules are simple: sixteen bars, then we switch,*
*No interrupting — Donald, I'm looking at you, don't twitch.*
*Our topics tonight: jobs, taxes, and America's soul,*
*Whoever spits the hottest fire takes the whole show.*
*Ladies and gentlemen — let's get ready to rumble,*
*First up: Secretary Clinton. Donald, don't grumble.*

---

### 🔵 HILLARY CLINTON — VERSE 1:

*Step up to the mic, I've been ready for years,*
*Thirty years of public service, blood, sweat, and tears.*
*First Lady, Senator, Secretary of State —*
*You wanna talk résumés? Mine is pretty great.*
*I've got a plan for jobs, for college, for the poor,*
*Check HillaryClinton.com — I've got a fact-check for sure.*
*You talk about deals? Your deals went Chapter 11,*
*Six bankruptcies, Donald — that ain't close to heaven.*
*You won't release your taxes, whatcha got to hide?*
*Maybe you ain't rich, or maybe something's wrong inside.*
*I'll invest in clean energy, build the middle class right,*
*And I will be your president — I'm ready for this fight.*
*I've been called every name — "nasty," "crooked," "wrong" —*
*But I'm still standin' here, and I'm still going strong.*
*So when you say I lack stamina, I just have to laugh —*
*I stood eleven hours before Congress on your behalf.*

---

*[Crowd reacts. Trump leans into the mic.]*

---

### 🔴 DONALD TRUMP — VERSE 1:

*Believe me, believe me, this woman is a disaster,*
*She's been in politics thirty years — coulda worked faster!*
*Thirty years of talking, what do you have to show?*
*Our jobs are gone to Mexico, China — they're runnin' the show!*
*NAFTA? Your husband signed it, wrecked the working man,*
*I'll rip it up and rewrite it — that's my master plan.*
*You got a private server? That don't sound too smart,*
*33,000 emails — deleted from the start.*
*She says she made a mistake — folks, that's a disgrace,*
*If I did something like that, I'd be locked in a case.*
*And speaking of locked up — maybe that's where you belong,*
*You've been wrong on everything, wrong, wrong, wrong, wrong!*
*I built an empire — towers kissing the sky,*
*What'd you build, Hillary? Excuses? That's a lie.*
*I'll bring back the jobs, make America great,*
*I'm Donald J. Trump, and I'll Make America… wait for it… GREAT.*

---

*[Air horn. The crowd is absolutely unhinged.]*

---

**LESTER HOLT:**
*Okay okay, settle down, we're keeping this civil,*
*Though I'll admit this battle's getting medieval.*
*Round two — the topic is temperament and style.*
*Hillary, you're up. Give us something worthwhile.*

---

### 🔵 HILLARY — VERSE 2:

*You wanna talk temperament? Oh, that's a rich one,*
*You called Miss Universe "Miss Piggy" — nice job, son.*
*You said Megyn Kelly had blood coming from wherever,*
*You think that's presidential? Man, come on, never.*
*I've sat in the Situation Room when things got hot,*
*I've shaken hands with world leaders — you have not.*
*You praised Putin like he was your favorite pen pal,*
*Meanwhile our intelligence says Russia's comin' for y'all.*
*You say you've got the best words — well, here's a few:*
*Empathy, diplomacy, and truth — ever heard those? It's new!*
*I wore a pantsuit to this battle, pressed and pristine,*
*While you sniffed through the microphone like a bad quarantine.*
*You told me I don't have the look — the presidential face,*
*I said: Donald, deal with it. I am taking your place.*

---

### 🔴 TRUMP — VERSE 2:

*She's blaming everything on me, but let's talk about Abe,*
*She blamed her Wall Street speeches on Lincoln — that's depraved!*
*"I was just like Lincoln" — oh, give me a break,*
*Lincoln never deleted emails — that's a fact, not fake!*
*I know the best people, I'll hire only the best,*
*My buildings are tremendous — they pass every test.*
*You say I didn't pay my taxes? I call that smart,*
*I used the laws that your people wrote — that's just fine art.*
*You got paid by Wall Street, you got paid to speak,*
*Then you tell the workers that their future looks bleak?*
*I've got tremendous support — the farmers, the miners,*
*The people forgotten by you Washington designers.*
*And by the way, Lester — I think this mic is bad,*
*Someone's sabotaging me — and that makes me mad.*
*But I'll still win — believe me, this race is done,*
*Because I'm Donald Trump, and I have already won!*

---

*[Clinton sighs audibly. The crowd erupts.]*

---

**LESTER HOLT:**
*Alright, alright — we've reached the final round,*
*Last sixteen bars — lay it all down.*
*The topic: what kind of America do you see?*
*Hillary, then Donald — after you, Secretary.*

---

### 🔵 HILLARY — VERSE 3 (CLOSER):

*I see an America that's stronger together,*
*Where we lift each other up through stormy weather.*
*Where a little girl can grow up knowing her worth,*
*Not be ranked on her looks from the moment of birth.*
*I see healthcare for all — not ripped away,*
*Twenty million people covered — they should get to stay.*
*I see a climate plan, clean energy jobs,*
*Not a man who calls science a hoax with a mob.*
*I've been knocked down, called names, dragged through the mud,*
*But I get back up — that's just in my blood.*
*So yes I've been in politics for thirty-odd years —*
*I've been fighting for you through the laughter and tears.*
*And when November comes and you step up to vote,*
*Remember who showed up prepared — remember this quote:*
*"When they go low, we go high" — that's my brand,*
*Now if you'll excuse me, I've got a country to land.*

---

### 🔴 TRUMP — VERSE 3 (CLOSER):

*America, they've forgotten about you — not me,*
*I see factories and steel mills and a country that's free.*
*I see a wall — a great wall — believe me, it's true,*
*Mexico's gonna pay for it, what else is new?*
*I see a military so strong, so powerful, so great,*
*Other countries will think twice before they mess with our fate.*
*I'll renegotiate every deal — NAFTA, TPP,*
*Put America first — that's my simple decree.*
*She says "Stronger Together" — together with who?*
*The donors, the lobbyists, the Wall Street crew?*
*I'm self-funded, baby — I don't owe anyone,*
*When I'm in the White House, the swamp will be done.*
